facts.statement: Caribospiza is a newly described genus and species of bird.
The genus Caribospiza was named by Viñola-López et al.
Caribospiza lived during the Quaternary period.
Fossils of Caribospiza were found in the Dominican Republic.
Caribospiza belongs to the family Accipitridae.
facts.quote: A member of the family Accipitridae.

facts.statement: The genus Caribospiza includes the species Caribospiza dodi.
facts.quote: Genus includes new species C. dodi.

facts.statement: The study describing Caribospiza was published in the Journal of Ornithology in 2026.
Authors of the Caribospiza study are Lázaro W. Viñola-López, Francisco das Chagas Silva-Neto, Juan N. Almonte-Milán, Beatriz Dybas da Natividade, and Sebastian Bocio.
